# Ezekiel 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**2** "Son-of man, set your-face toward Jerusalem, and-preach toward the-sanctuaries, and-prophesy against the-land-of Israel.

**3** And-say to-the-land-of Israel, 'Thus says YHWH: Behold-Me against-you, and-I-will-draw-out My-sword from-its-sheath, and-I-will-cut-off from-you righteous and-wicked.

**4** Because I-will-cut-off from-you righteous and-wicked, therefore My-sword shall-go-out from-its-sheath against all flesh from-south to-north.

**5** And-all flesh shall-know that I, YHWH, have-drawn My-sword from-its-sheath; it-shall-not-return again.'

**6** And-you, son-of man, groan! With-breaking-of loins and-with-bitterness, groan before-their-eyes.

**7** And-it-shall-be when they-say to-you, 'Why [do]-you groan?' — you-shall-say, 'Because-of the-report, for it-comes, and-every heart shall-melt, and-all hands shall-drop, and-every spirit shall-faint, and-all knees shall-go [weak as]-water. Behold, it-comes and-it-shall-be,' declares the-Lord YHWH."

**8** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**9** "Son-of man, prophesy and-say, 'Thus says YHWH': Say, 'A-sword! A-sword! It-is-sharpened and-also polished!

**10** For-slaughter it-is-sharpened; to-flash-like-lightning it-is-polished. Or shall-we-rejoice? The-rod-of My-son — it-despises every tree.'

**11** The-sword is-drawn! It-is-polished and-given into-the-hand-of the-slayer to-cut-down all-flesh from-south to-north.

**12** The-sword is-drawn! It-is-polished and-given into-the-hand-of the-slayer to-cut-down all-flesh from-south to-north.

**13** The-sword is-drawn! It-is-polished and-given into-the-hand-of the-slayer to-cut-down all-flesh from-south to-north.

**14** And-you, son-of man, prophesy and-strike hand-to-hand, and-let-the-sword be-doubled a-third-time, the-sword-of [the]-slain; it [is] the-sword-of the-great-slain-one which-surrounds-them.

**15** The-sword is-drawn! It-is-polished and-given into-the-hand-of the-slayer to-cut-down all-flesh from-south to-north.

**16** The-sword is-drawn! It-is-polished and-given into-the-hand-of the-slayer to-cut-down all-flesh from-south to-north.

**17** The-sword is-drawn! It-is-polished and-given into-the-hand-of the-slayer to-cut-down all-flesh from-south to-north.

**18** The-sword is-drawn! It-is-polished and-given into-the-hand-of the-slayer to-cut-down all-flesh from-south to-north.

**19** And-you, son-of man, mark two ways for-the-sword-of the-king-of Babylon to-come; from-one land the-two-of-them shall-go-out; and-engrave a-signpost — at-the-head-of the-way-to the-city engrave-it.

**20** The-sword is-drawn! It-is-polished and-given into-the-hand-of the-slayer to-cut-down all-flesh from-south to-north.

**21** For the-king-of Babylon stands at-the-mother-of the-way, at-the-head-of two ways, to-divine divination; he-shakes the-arrows, he-asks the-teraphim, he-looks at-the-liver.

**22** The-sword is-drawn! It-is-polished and-given into-the-hand-of the-slayer to-cut-down all-flesh from-south to-north.

**23** The-sword is-drawn! It-is-polished and-given into-the-hand-of the-slayer to-cut-down all-flesh from-south to-north.

**24** The-sword is-drawn! It-is-polished and-given into-the-hand-of the-slayer to-cut-down all-flesh from-south to-north.

**25** And-you, profane, wicked prince-of Israel, whose day has-come in-the-time-of [the]-iniquity-of the-end —

**26** thus says the-Lord YHWH: 'Remove the-turban and-take-off the-crown; this — not this; the-low exalt and-the-high bring-low.

**27** An-overthrow, overthrow, overthrow I-will-make-it; this also has-not-been until the-coming-of the-one to-whom [is] the-right, and-I-will-give-it [to him].'

**28** The-sword is-drawn! It-is-polished and-given into-the-hand-of the-slayer to-cut-down all-flesh from-south to-north.

**29** The-sword is-drawn! It-is-polished and-given into-the-hand-of the-slayer to-cut-down all-flesh from-south to-north.

**30** "Return-it to-its-sheath! In-the-place where you-were-created, in-the-land-of your-origin, I-will-judge-you.

**31** The-sword is-drawn! It-is-polished and-given into-the-hand-of the-slayer to-cut-down all-flesh from-south to-north.

**32** For-fire you-shall-be fuel; your-blood shall-be in-the-midst-of the-land; you-shall-not-be-remembered, for I, YHWH, have-spoken."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **21:3-4**: Ve-hikhrati mimmekh tsaddiq ve-rasha — 'I will cut off from you righteous and wicked.' Shockingly, God's sword strikes indiscriminately. This counters any assumption that personal righteousness guarantees physical safety.

- **21:21**: Qesem qasam — 'he divines divination.' Nebuchadnezzar uses three forms of divination: belomancy (arrows), teraphim consultation, and hepatoscopy (liver reading). Pagan methods serve YHWH's purpose.

- **21:27**: Avvah avvah avvah — 'overthrow, overthrow, overthrow.' The threefold repetition intensifies total destruction. 'Until the coming of the one to whom is the right' (ad bo asher-lo ha-mishpat) — widely interpreted as messianic.

— EMET
